in_hebrew.name: ישיה
in_hebrew.meaning: ישיהו - ישוע ישע יהוה (Yeshiyahu - Yeshua Yish'a Yahweh)
in_hebrew.long_meaning: ישיהו הוא שם עברי שפירושו 'ישוע הוא ישע יהוה' או 'אלוהים הוא הישועה'. השם נגזר מהשמות ישוע וישע, ומציין את הקשר בין האל לבין ישוע המשיח. השם ישיהו מופיע במקרא כהשם של מספר אישים, ביניהם נביא ומלך ביהודה.

in_greek.name: Υεσίας
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Υεσίας προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή λέξη 'ישיהו' (Yeshiyahu), που σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός είναι η σωτηρία' ή 'Ο Θεός救ζει'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, το όνομα αυτό δεν αναφέρεται άμεσα, αλλά η έννοια της σωτηρίας μέσω του Θεού είναι κεντρική στο Χριστιανισμό.

in_latin.name: Yesiah
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Yesiah derivatum est ex hebraeo 'ישיהו' (Yeshiyahu), quod significat 'Deus salus est' vel 'Deus servat'. Nomen hoc in traditione christiana significat salutem per Deum, quae est fundamentum fidei christianae.

in_english.name: Yesiah
in_english.meaning: God is salvation or God saves
in_english.long_meaning: The name Yesiah is derived from the Hebrew name 'ישיהו' (Yeshiyahu), meaning 'God is salvation' or 'God saves'. It is related to the names Joshua and Isaiah, and signifies the importance of God's salvation in Christian tradition. The name has been adopted in various Christian cultures, symbolizing faith in God's redemptive power.

data.cultural_impact: The name Yesiah holds significant cultural impact for Christians, as it is derived from the Hebrew name Yeshua, which is believed to be the actual historical name of Jesus Christ. In Christianity, Jesus is revered as the savior of humanity, and the name Yesiah symbolizes the salvation that can be found through faith in Him.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Yesiah carries deep spiritual significance for Christians, emphasizing the idea that through faith in God, individuals can find salvation and release from their sins. It serves as a reminder of the sacrificial love and divine intervention manifested through Jesus' life, death, and resurrection. Ultimately, the name Yesiah underscores the transformative power of faith and hope in a higher power.
